effects_provenance.raw: Runtz THCA Flower Essential / 28g Strain Profile Runtz THCA Flower is a celebrated hybrid created by crossing two legendary genetics: the candy-sweet Zkittlez and the creamy, dessert-like Gelato , bred by the renowned Cookies Fam . The cultivar is responsible for an entire family of modern crosses — the original frost-blanketed, fruit-candy bag appeal that built the modern Runtz category. Effects Runtz delivers a balanced experience that pairs uplifting cerebral euphoria with comfortable body relaxation. The high feels social and pleasant — suitable for daytime use, group settings, or evening flavor-led decompression — with the kind of broadly-pleasing character that earned this strain its modern legend status. Flavor & Aroma On the palate: sugary candy sweetness up front, with tropical fruits through the middle and a subtle floral-creamy finish on the exhale. Smoke is smooth and unmistakably bright. The terpene profile reads candy-and-tropical-fruit — see the COA for the exact terpene breakdown of the current batch. Lab Tested — View the COA Every Runtz harvest is third-party tested for cannabinoid content, terpenes, residual solvents, pesticides, and heavy metals. Download the Runtz THCA Flower Certificate of Analysis for full test results. Tiers Explained Our three quality tiers are: Supreme — Hand-selected top-shelf buds with the densest structure, highest trichome coverage, and strongest terpene expression. Preferred — Premium-grade flower at a balanced price, using the same genetics and cultivation with a slightly broader bud selection. Essential — Our value tier, using the same strain and lab testing with smaller or more uniform buds. Federally Compliant Hemp Lit Farms Runtz THCA Flower is hemp-derived and federally compliant under the 2018 Farm Bill — containing less than 0.3% Δ9-THC by dry weight at harvest. Must be 21+ to purchase. Not for sale in jurisdictions where THCA flower is restricted. Explore our full THCA Flower collection for more strains.
